title: WizardLM: Empowering large pre-trained language models to follow complex instructions
authors_zh: Can Xu, Qingfeng Sun, Kai Zheng, Xiubo Geng, Pu Zhao, Jiazhan Feng, Chongyang Tao, Qingwei Lin, Daxin Jiang
paper_type_zh: 演化式指令—回答数据构造
best_for_zh: 适合把简单种子扩展成更难 SFT 任务、并要求来源链可审计的研究者。
one_line: WizardLM turns 52K seed instructions into a 250K candidate pool through explicit depth and breadth operations before teacher answering.
WizardLM 用显式深度和广度操作把 52K 条种子指令扩展成 250K 候选，再生成教师回答。
why: It makes the intended increase in instruction difficulty traceable before the response becomes SFT supervision.
inclusion_reason: WizardLM evolves seed instructions through explicit complexity and breadth transformations before generating teacher answers.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction-tuning datasets built from a few seeds tend to preserve simple requests and a narrow difficulty distribution. Writing many complex instructions by hand is expensive, while ordinary Self-Instruct generation does not explicitly control how a task becomes harder.

WizardLM introduces Evol-Instruct: use an LLM to rewrite seed instructions through depth operations that add constraints or reasoning demands and breadth operations that create new task types, then generate teacher answers and train a student. Starting from Alpaca's 52K instructions, four evolution rounds produce 250K instructions; a matched 70K subset trains the reported LLaMA-13B WizardLM.

L4 facts: primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.12244; ICLR 2024; boundary: synthetic post-training instruction-response data, not pretraining or verified reasoning; atlas value: explicit seed-to-evolution lineage; evaluation surface: nine benchmarks plus the 218-instruction WizardEval set.

由少量种子构建的指令微调数据往往保留简单请求，难度分布也比较窄。人工编写大量复杂指令成本很高，而普通 Self-Instruct 生成没有显式控制任务如何变难。

WizardLM 提出 Evol-Instruct：用 LLM 通过增加约束或推理要求的深度操作，以及创造新任务类型的广度操作改写种子指令，再生成教师回答并训练学生模型。它从 Alpaca 的 52K 条指令出发，经过四轮演化得到 250K 条指令；论文从中抽取配置匹配的 70K 子集，训练 LLaMA-13B 版本的 WizardLM。

L4 事实：主要来源为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.12244；ICLR 2024；边界是合成后训练指令—回答数据，而非预训练或经过验证的推理数据；图谱价值是显式记录从种子到演化结果的来源链；评测包括九个 benchmark 和含 218 条指令的 WizardEval。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Evol-Instruct makes instruction difficulty and breadth explicit construction variables: every accepted record links a seed, an evolution operator, an evolved instruction, and a teacher response. Compared with Self-Instruct, it targets controlled complexity rather than more samples of similar difficulty; compared with UltraChat, it produces single instruction-response pairs rather than contextual conversations. The OpenAI model authors both the evolved request and its answer, while rule checks filter malformed evolutions; no independent verifier establishes answer or reasoning correctness.

Google Scholar citations: 1736（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=WizardLM%3A+Empowering+large+pre-trained+language+models+to+follow+complex+instructions&author=Can+Xu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Evol-Instruct / WizardLM instruction data, https://github.com/nlpxucan/WizardLM, includes paper-related JSON instruction-response releases for SFT. The paper creates a 250K evolved pool from 52K Alpaca instructions and uses a random 70K subset in the matched LLaMA-13B experiment; records contain an evolved instruction and teacher output, with seed/operator lineage needed for a full audit. The repository has received later dataset revisions, so users must pin the exact file, count, format, and license before training or redistribution.

Evol-Instruct 把指令难度和广度变成显式构造变量：每条接纳记录都连接种子、演化操作、演化后指令和教师回答。与 Self-Instruct 相比，它追求可控复杂度，而不只是生成更多相似难度样本；与 UltraChat 相比，它产出单条指令—回答，而不是带上下文的对话。OpenAI 模型同时编写演化请求和回答，规则检查负责过滤畸形演化，但没有独立验证器保证回答或推理正确。

Google Scholar 引用数：1736（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=WizardLM%3A+Empowering+large+pre-trained+language+models+to+follow+complex+instructions&author=Can+Xu&hl=en）

开源数据：有。Evol-Instruct / WizardLM 指令数据位于 https://github.com/nlpxucan/WizardLM，包含论文相关的 JSON 指令—回答文件，可用于 SFT。论文从 52K 条 Alpaca 指令构造 250K 条演化候选，并在配置匹配的 LLaMA-13B 实验中随机使用 70K 条；记录包含演化指令和教师输出，完整审计还需保留种子和操作来源链。仓库后来发布过其他版本，训练或再分发前必须固定具体文件、数量、格式和许可证。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Initialize seeds. Input: 52K Alpaca instructions. Operation: attach an evolution-round identifier and preserve the original text. Output: the current instruction pool. Check: keep seed identity so later complexity claims remain traceable.
  1. Evolve in depth. Input: a current instruction and one of five prompts. Operation: add constraints, deepen inquiry, make the request concrete, require more reasoning steps, or complicate the input. Output: a harder candidate instruction. Check: reject evolutions that do not add information, cannot be answered, or merely copy the seed.
  1. Evolve in breadth. Input: a seed or current instruction. Operation: ask the OpenAI dialogue model to create a rarer, differently scoped task inspired by it. Output: a new task type rather than a restatement. Check: enforce plausibility, clarity, and non-duplication.
  1. Generate answers and iterate. Input: accepted evolved instructions and the OpenAI dialogue model. Operation: generate target responses, merge the new records, and repeat evolution for four rounds. Output: 250K instruction-response candidates. Check: save teacher/version, operator, round, and filtering decision.
  1. Train and evaluate. Input: a random 70K candidate subset and LLaMA 13B. Operation: SFT the student and compare it with Alpaca, Vicuna, and other 13B models on common benchmarks and WizardEval. Output: WizardLM and evaluation scores. Check: match data size and base model when attributing gains to Evol-Instruct.

1. 初始化种子。 输入是 52K 条 Alpaca 指令。为每条指令附加演化轮次，并保留原始文本，产出当前指令池。必须保存种子身份，才能追踪后续复杂度主张。
  1. 进行深度演化。 输入是一条当前指令和五类提示之一。操作包括增加约束、加深问题、使请求更具体、要求更多推理步骤或增加输入复杂度，产出更难的候选指令。若改写没有增加信息、无法回答或只是复制种子，就应拒绝。
  1. 进行广度演化。 输入是种子或当前指令。让 OpenAI 对话模型受其启发创建更少见、范围不同的任务，产出新的任务类型而不是同义改写。检查任务是否合理、清楚且不重复。
  1. 生成回答并迭代。 输入是通过筛选的演化指令和 OpenAI 对话模型。为每条指令生成目标回答，合并新记录并重复四轮，产出 250K 条指令—回答候选。应保存教师及版本、演化操作、轮次和过滤决定。
  1. 训练并评测。 输入是随机抽取的 70K 条候选和 LLaMA 13B。通过 SFT 得到 WizardLM，再与 Alpaca、Vicuna 等 13B 模型在通用 benchmark 和 WizardEval 上比较，产出模型与分数。只有数据量和基座匹配时，才能把差异归因于 Evol-Instruct。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Matched 13B comparison (Table 1). WizardLM, Vicuna, and the expanded Alpaca baseline use LLaMA 13B and 70K instruction examples, but differ in construction: Evol-Instruct synthetic data, user-shared conversations, and Self-Instruct data respectively. Across MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, HumanEval, GSM8K, AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and WizardEval, WizardLM averages 58.96, versus 54.60 for Vicuna and 43.44 for Alpaca. On the 218-instruction WizardEval surface it scores 89.1, versus Vicuna's 86.9. This supports the complete evolution-and-answer pipeline under a matched base/size, but not correctness of every generated item or the contribution of any single operator.

配置匹配的 13B 比较（表 1）。 WizardLM、Vicuna 和扩展后的 Alpaca 基线都使用 LLaMA 13B 与 70K 条指令样本，但构造方式分别是 Evol-Instruct 合成数据、用户共享对话和 Self-Instruct 数据。在 MMLU、ARC、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、HumanEval、GSM8K、AlpacaEval、MT-Bench 和 WizardEval 上，WizardLM 平均分为 58.96，Vicuna 为 54.60，Alpaca 为 43.44；在含 218 条指令的 WizardEval 上，WizardLM 得分 89.1，Vicuna 为 86.9。这支持在基座和数据量匹配时整套演化与回答流程有效，但不能证明每条生成数据正确，也不能隔离单个演化操作的贡献。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Self-Instruct is the closest baseline: it expands seeds but does not explicitly steer difficulty. Evol-Instruct adds named depth and breadth operators, making the transformation from seed to training request an inspectable decision. Teacher generation and SFT are established techniques; the new object is the controlled evolution lineage at 250K-candidate scale. The method signals that instruction complexity can be designed before response generation, although it does not verify the resulting answers.
最接近的基线是 Self-Instruct：它扩展种子，但没有显式控制难度。Evol-Instruct 加入有名称的深度和广度操作，使从种子到训练请求的变换成为可检查的决定。教师生成和 SFT 都是已有技术；新的对象是在 250K 候选规模上记录的受控演化来源链。它说明可以在生成回答之前设计指令复杂度，但并不验证最终回答。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Complexity proxy. An evolved instruction can be longer without requiring a harder decision; compare operator-specific examples and human difficulty judgments rather than token length alone.
  • Unverified teacher targets. The same proprietary teacher rewrites requests and answers them, so errors can pass directly into SFT; add an independent answer or execution check for factual and reasoning tasks.
  • Evaluation dependence. The paper acknowledges limits of GPT-4 and small human evaluations; rerun a pinned judge and task-specific tests before using WizardEval gains as a deployment claim.

• 复杂度只是代理量。 演化指令可能只是更长，并没有增加真正的决策难度；应比较不同操作的样本和人工难度判断，而不能只看 token 数。
  • 教师目标未经验证。 同一个专有教师既改写请求又回答请求，错误可能直接进入 SFT；事实与推理任务需要增加独立答案检查或执行检查。
  • 评测依赖。 论文承认 GPT-4 评判和小规模人工评测的限制；把 WizardEval 收益用于部署主张前，应固定评判模型并运行任务专用测试。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Evol-Instruct when a seed instruction set is too easy or narrow for the desired SFT model. Supply versioned seeds, depth/breadth prompts, a pinned teacher, and filters; output instruction-response JSON with seed, operator, round, answer, and acceptance metadata. Success means human or task-specific checks confirm increased difficulty and a matched student improves on the target distribution. Do not use it alone for preference learning, multi-turn context, or domains where teacher answers require formal correctness.
当种子指令对目标 SFT 模型而言过于简单或狭窄时，可以使用 Evol-Instruct。输入有版本记录的种子、深度与广度提示、固定教师和过滤器，输出带种子、操作、轮次、回答与接纳元数据的指令—回答 JSON。成功标准是人工或任务专用检查确认难度确实增加，而且配置匹配的学生模型在目标分布上提升。它不能单独解决偏好学习、多轮上下文，或要求教师回答形式化正确的领域。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: Evol-Instruct changes the request before generating its answer; the evolution lineage is the central data object.
  2. Use when: seed instructions are too easy or cover too few task types.
  3. Record: seed, depth/breadth operator, round, evolved instruction, teacher answer, and filter decision.
  4. Do not infer: a longer request, a correct final benchmark score, or a GPT-4 preference proves each training answer correct.
  5. Audit first: pin the teacher and released file, sample operator-specific failures, and compare a matched 70K baseline.

1. 应记住： Evol-Instruct 先改变请求再生成回答，演化来源链是核心数据对象。
  2. 适用条件： 种子指令太简单，或覆盖的任务类型太少。
  3. 必须记录： 种子、深度或广度操作、轮次、演化指令、教师回答和过滤决定。
  4. 不能推出： 请求更长、最终 benchmark 分数正确或 GPT-4 偏好，都不能证明每条训练回答正确。
  5. 扩展前审计： 固定教师和发布文件，抽查不同操作的失败样本，并与配置匹配的 70K 基线比较。
